title: [GMCP 203.020.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: GMCP server authoring SDK and plugin lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-020-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: A stable Susi-shaped authoring SDK builds local MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, MRTR handlers, tasks and extensions with schema derivation, typed context, middleware, testing fixtures and hot reload. Plugins declare permissions and compatibility, initialize transactionally, unload without leaks, preserve no vendor types across the boundary, and ship runnable minimal through production examples. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Adversarial and failure behavior (`GMCP-203-020-04`) hardens panic/crash isolation across SDK request dispatch, durable `TaskManager` tasks, and plugin `initializer`/`on_unload` hooks (`CatchUnwind`), enforces in-flight SDK tool cancellation on `notifications/cancelled`, binds `verify_pack_dir_for_sdk` and `sync_active_pack` to host `state.json` quarantine/TOFU signer-digest checks with immediate compromised-plugin eviction, and verifies deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures; subsequent vector stages (`T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-111`..`113`) add interop/version matrix, operations/scale, and final `.M` mastery suites.

Per `docs/gmcp-roadmap.md`, `docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md`, and zero-UI plan A9, Core ships zero bundled vendor plugin packs (`DEFAULT_PACK_ID = "default"`; curated packs live in Susi Commercial Apps), and `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-020.jsonl` plus `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-020.json` stay absent until `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-113` (`.M` Mastery).

reuse.why: Hardened existing `GmcpService`, `serve_inner`, `TaskManager`, `sync_active_pack`, and `verify_pack_dir_for_sdk` production paths with `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` panic containment, request cancellation, and host TOFU/quarantine eviction rather than introducing parallel error or supervisor layers.
